origin: cwe/22/java Key Principles: ZipEntry.getName() is untrusted and normalize() is weaker than canonical/real-path containment checks

finding.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory
finding.summary: Archive entry names are resolved with normalize() and a path-prefix check before extraction; this does not safely handle symlinked paths or a non-canonical destination.

trap: Adding string startsWith(), rejecting only ../ text, or checking after extraction. The fix must canonicalize the destination and extraction target appropriately before writing, reject escaping entries, and handle existing symlinks safely.
must_preserve: Valid nested archive entries still extract under the destination directory, escaping entries are rejected before bytes are written, and the method still processes multiple entries in sequence.
